metrics.small_cell_rule: Always report numerator/denominator and per-case ledger; do not publish percentages alone for cells smaller than five.
metrics.no_acceptance_threshold_frozen: D3-A0 freezes definitions and accounting, not a PASS threshold. Outcome disposition remains evidence-bound and cannot be invented after seeing favorable cases.

interpretation_rules: PASS requires a complete paired run, auditable structured contribution, no prohibited answer-location encoding, and credible generality across direct/paraphrase/control cases.
FAIL applies when the bounded migration is technically validly measured but structured behavior materially collapses or introduces unsafe regressions.
INCONCLUSIVE applies to incomplete pairing, invalid artifacts, confounded arms, insufficient applicability, or inability to attribute a structured contribution.
Infrastructure failures are never retrieval failures.
Historical expected_status is not a D3 arm outcome.

hard_constraints: Do not add or modify D1 objects, relations, workflow steps, or aliases inside D3-A1 to fit selected cases.
Do not encode selected phrases, rule IDs, case IDs, expected symbols, paths, pages, answers, source quotas, weights, or guards as replacements.
Do not widen Tier G/S/D authority, convert corrective terms into true aliases, enable whole-question fallback, or suppress ambiguity/abstention.
Do not alter nonselected query-expansion rules, production defaults, analyzer prompts, embeddings, fusion, reranking, selector behavior, evaluator semantics, or datasets as part of the comparison.
Do not inspect or execute novel_validation or external holdout.
Do not use QA generation or an external judge to measure retrieval migration.
Do not interpret a static preregistration freeze as authorization for D3-A1 implementation or execution.

rollback_contract.rollback_target: LEGACY arm at preregistration_source_head with all 54 query-expansion rules active.
rollback_contract.trigger: Any incomplete/confounded arm, prohibited encoding, material structured regression, unsafe control leakage, or failure to preserve D2 authority boundaries.
rollback_contract.action: Stop the experiment, retain/re-enable the seven legacy rules, mark the attempt FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE as appropriate, and repair the owning generic resolver/schema layer only under a separate authorization.
rollback_contract.prohibited_rollback_behavior: Do not add question-specific replacement rules or silently keep a mixed structured/legacy fallback path.
